timer_by_id.brief: 按 id 查找定时器 / Find a timer by its id

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

timer_by_id.return: 命中的定时器指针，未找到返回 `NULL` / Pointer to the timer, or `NULL` when not found

timer_remove.brief: 从队列中删除一个定时器 / Remove a timer from the queue

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.t: inout:要移除的定时器（指向 `js->timers` 内部）/ The timer to remove, pointing into `js->timers`

timer_remove.note: 用指针差定位下标，索引越界时静默返回；其余项用 `memmove` 前移 / The index is computed by pointer difference and out-of-range values return silently; later entries shift down via `memmove`

timer_grow.brief: 追加一个定时器槽位并返回其指针 / Append a timer slot and return a pointer to it

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

timer_grow.return: 指向新追加的定时器槽位 / Pointer to the newly appended timer slot
timer_grow.note: 在 arena 中重新分配更大的数组并拷贝旧项，`timer_count` 自增 / A larger array is arena-allocated and copied, and `timer_count` is incremented

native_set_timeout.brief: `setTimeout` / `setInterval` 的原生实现 / Native implementation of `setTimeout` and `setInterval`

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.thisv: 调用时的 `this`（未使用）/ The `this` of the call (unused)
params.args: 实参数组：`[回调, 毫秒数]` / Argument array: `[callback, milliseconds]`

native_set_timeout.return: 新定时器的 id；首参不是函数时返回 -1 / The new timer id, or -1 when the first argument is not a function
native_set_timeout.note: 延迟小于 0 被夹为 0，且按秒换算成绝对到期时刻 / A negative delay is clamped to 0 and converted to an absolute deadline in seconds

native_clear_timer.brief: `clearTimeout` / `clearInterval` 的原生实现 / Native implementation of `clearTimeout` and `clearInterval`

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.thisv: 调用时的 `this`（未使用）/ The `this` of the call (unused)
params.ud: 用户数据（未使用，`setTimeout`/`setInterval` 共用同一实现）/ User data (unused; the same implementation backs both variants)

native_clear_timer.note: 无参数或 id 不存在时不做事 / Does nothing without an argument or when the id is unknown

native_request_animation_frame.brief: `requestAnimationFrame` 的原生实现 / Native implementation of `requestAnimationFrame`

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.thisv: 调用时的 `this`（未使用）/ The `this` of the call (unused)
params.args: 实参数组：`[回调]` / Argument array: `[callback]`
params.ud: 用户数据（未使用）/ User data (unused)

native_request_animation_frame.note: 入队时 id 为 0、`is_raf` 置 1、到期时刻为 0，因此每轮泵都会执行 / The queued entry has id 0, `is_raf` set and a zero deadline, so it runs on every pump round

hpe_js_run_timers.brief: 执行到期定时器与 rAF 回调 / Run due timers and rAF callbacks

params.js: JS 运行时上下文，可为 `NULL` / JS runtime context, may be `NULL`
params.now: 当前时间（秒），与定时器到期时刻同基准 / Current time in seconds, on the same basis as the deadlines
params.fired: out:置 1 表示确有回调执行（可有 NULL）/ Set to 1 when any callback actually ran; may be `NULL`

hpe_js_run_timers.return: 实际执行的回调个数 / The number of callbacks that actually ran
hpe_js_run_timers.details: 倒序遍历队列：rAF 与到期的非重复定时器执行后出队，重复定时器顺延到下一个到期时刻；回调经 `hpe_js_call` 调用，返回 0 说明正常执行才计数。| The queue is walked backwards; rAF entries and due one-shot timers are removed after running while repeating timers advance to their next deadline; callbacks run through `hpe_js_call` and only a zero return counts as having run.

hpe_js_timers_install.brief: 在全局对象上安装定时器与 rAF / Install the timer and rAF functions on the global object

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
